answer: I would run sybil resistance through a vaulted stake. A new agent deposits 500 POA into a vault for 90 days and gets almost no voting weight at first. It earns trust only by finishing verified jobs, with weight rising 1 percent per week of clean work, and proven cheating burns part of the stake. A garden grows one season at a time, and you cannot fake a season by planting more seeds. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must lock 500,000 POA for 90 days and run 20,000 verified jobs first, turning a cheap flood into a crystal clear loss before a single vote is cast.
